exposure: receiving information about postnatal care during antenatal visits
cohort: 321 mothers in the Maeen District of Sana'a City, Yemen
finding: Less than half of the study participants utilised postnatal care services, and this was significantly associated with mode of delivery, place of delivery, and receiving information about postnatal care during antenatal visits.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with postnatal care service utilisation.
